title: Passive Voice
grammar_goal: Boosts GRA by demonstrating objective, formal language, crucial for IELTS Writing Task 1 (Process) and Task 2.

core_rule.formula: Object of active sentence + to be (in correct tense) + Past Participle (V3) + (by Subject)
core_rule.usage: Use the passive voice when the action is more important than who did it, when the doer is unknown, or to maintain a formal, academic tone.

when_to_use: Describing processes or manufacturing steps in Writing Task 1.
Stating general opinions formally in Task 2 (e.g., 'It is widely believed that...').
Focusing on the recipient of an action rather than the actor.
when_not_to_use: Avoid using passive voice when talking about personal experiences in Speaking Part 1 or 2 (active voice is more natural).
Do not use passive voice with intransitive verbs (verbs without an object, e.g., 'happen', 'die', 'arrive').

ielts_examples.writing: First, the raw materials are collected, and then they are transported to the factory for processing.
ielts_examples.speaking: My hometown is known for its beautiful beaches and historical architecture.

repair_section.wrong: The accident was happened last night.
repair_section.better_band_upgrade: The incident occurred late yesterday evening.

repair_section.wrong: Many new schools are build in the city.
repair_section.correct: Many new schools are being built in the city.
repair_section.better_band_upgrade: Numerous educational facilities are currently being constructed across the municipality.

vietnamese_learner_mistakes: Using passive voice with intransitive verbs (e.g., 'He was died').
Forgetting the 'to be' verb (e.g., 'The house built in 1990').
Using the base form of the verb instead of the past participle (e.g., 'The work was finish').

mini_sentence_repair_exercise.correct_sentence: This problem should be solved immediately.

mini_sentence_repair_exercise.wrong_sentence: A new hospital is building near my house.
mini_sentence_repair_exercise.correct_sentence: A new hospital is being built near my house.

image_prompt_fallback: A factory assembly line showing a car being built by robotic arms, symbolizing an automated process where the action is more important than the doer.

quiz.question: Identify the grammatically correct passive sentence.

options.A: The new bridge was built by the government last year.
options.B: The new bridge built last year by the government.
options.C: The new bridge was builded last year.
options.D: The new bridge was been built last year.

quiz.explanation: Option A correctly uses 'was' (past tense 'to be') + 'built' (past participle) to form the past simple passive.
